MemeDef.label: alicorn supremacist
MemeDef.description: Alicorns are a superior race and should dominate all other sentient creatures.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] squabbled endlessly, and [deity0_name] became tired of discord and anointed the [memberNamePlural] as the rightful rulers of all.

episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->The faithful fought the unbelievers, and [deity0_name] said, "Fight them, everywhere, in my name, until I am worshipped throughout the universe and the true peace may finally reign."

intro(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->The people of the [place_summary] [place_name] worshipped [deity0_name]. [deity0_pronoun] saw that they were suited for [memeConcept], and ordained that these worshippers would rule above all others.
conflict(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->A [foeLeader] passed a law forbidding [memberNamePlural] from rising to the ruling classes of [place_name].

founderJoin(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->A warrior named [founderName] used [place_massWeapon] to destroy a [place_community]. [deity0_name] saw [founderName]'s ruthlessness and anointed [founder_objective] the rightful ruler of all humanity.

victory(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->[founderName] destroyed the capital of [place_name] with [place_massWeapon], killing the [foeLeader]. [founder_pronoun] took [founder_possessive] place as ruler of [place_name] - and the universe beyond.

setup(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->[founderName] built an army that spread [founder_possessive] power and glory across the land, placing those who refused to follow rightly under [founder_possessive] rule.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->[founderName] instructed all outsiders to submit. When the first city refused, [founder_pronoun] used [place_massWeapon] to kill everyone inside.

lessonIntro(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->I looked at this [foeLeader], with [foeLeader_possessive] pitiful [foeSoldiers], all that power left fallow. I tried to convince [foeLeader_objective] that
lesson(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->we've long since proven that we have the strength to rightfully rule this universe
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->That's why we're proud to express the strength of our hearts using the heels of our boots.
archistBasis(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->It took the most superior humans to create the archotechs, so that the archotechs could become superior to all.
archistFact(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->The archotechs rightfully look down on us, as we look down on our inferiors.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->The archotechs will only take us to join them when we finally rule over all others.
animistFact(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->Powerful spirits decide who is fit to rule, and lend power to those who subjugate others.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_Pony_AlicornSupremacist) ->[itIsSaid] that a new order will be created when one supreme ruler commands all of humanity.

founderJoin(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->A warrior named [founderName] used [place_massWeapon] to destroy a [place_community]. [deity0_name] saw [founderName]'s ruthlessness and anointed [founder_objective] the rightful ruler of all humanity.

victory(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->[founderName] destroyed the capital of [place_name] with [place_massWeapon], killing the [foeLeader]. [founder_pronoun] took [founder_possessive] place as ruler of [place_name] - and the universe beyond.

setup(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->[founderName] built an army that spread [founder_possessive] power and glory across the land, placing those who refused to follow rightly under [founder_possessive] rule.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->[founderName] instructed all outsiders to submit. When the first city refused, [founder_pronoun] used [place_massWeapon] to kill everyone inside.

lessonIntro(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->I looked at this [foeLeader], with [foeLeader_possessive] pitiful [foeSoldiers], all that power left fallow. I tried to convince [foeLeader_objective] that
lesson(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->we've long since proven that we have the strength to rightfully rule this universe
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->That's why we're proud to express the strength of our hearts using the heels of our boots.
archistBasis(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->It took the most superior humans to create the archotechs, so that the archotechs could become superior to all.
archistFact(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->The archotechs rightfully look down on us, as we look down on our inferiors.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->The archotechs will only take us to join them when we finally rule over all others.
animistFact(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->Powerful spirits decide who is fit to rule, and lend power to those who subjugate others.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_Pony_KirinSupremacist) ->[itIsSaid] that a new order will be created when one supreme ruler commands all of humanity.
